Triage
Set how the triage agent repairs failing tests and delivers fixes.
Repair behavior
On successful heal

What the healing agent does after it repairs a test in CI. Outside CI, healed changes are always left on disk. Hover an option for details. Docs

On failed heal

What the healing agent does when it can't repair a test. Docs

Pull requests
Request commit authors as reviewers

Request a review from the authors of the commits behind a failure on its heal pull request.

Assign commit authors

Assign the authors of the commits behind a failure to its heal pull request.

Default reviewer

A GitHub username or org/team asked to review a repair when no reviewer is found or GitHub rejects every candidate. Not used when a triage skill selects reviewers.

Auto-close inactive pull requests

Close heal pull requests after this many days with no activity.
